title: Make use of the forum search facility

posts.topic_title: Make use of the forum search facility
posts.author: MichaelH
posts.post_subject: Make use of the forum search facility
posts.content_md:
While not a chemical, film or laser tip, using the search facility will save you a lot of time.

Loads of useful information has been discussed, argued and finally archived here and by doing just a few searches you may find that the information you need is ready and waiting in an older post.
